name: Building with the Claude API
summary: Free video course on building with the Claude API: prompting, tool use, RAG, MCP, caching, agents and evals.
description: An Anthropic Academy video course for developers integrating Claude into applications. It covers API setup and authentication, multi-turn conversations, system prompts, temperature, streaming and structured output, prompt evaluation, prompt engineering, tool use, RAG with embeddings and BM25, extended thinking, images, PDFs, citations and prompt caching, MCP servers and clients, Claude Code and computer use, and agent workflows. Prerequisites are Python and JSON; registration is free.
contains: free registration; prerequisites: Python and JSON
API access, auth, multi-turn conversations, system prompts, streaming and structured output
prompt evaluation: test datasets, model-based and code-based grading
tool use: schemas, multiple tools, web search, text edit tool
RAG: chunking, embeddings, BM25 and a multi-index pipeline
features: extended thinking, images, PDFs, citations, prompt caching, Files API
Claude Code, computer use and agent workflows (parallelization, chaining, routing)
